name: fresh-blue-fashion-ivy-arch
image_purpose: Fashion social post and outfit showcase

prompt.project_info: Create a full-body pastel street-fashion portrait of an approved adult woman at a lush ivy-covered garden gate.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult platinum-blonde woman with long wavy hair and fair skin, wearing a light blue fabric headband, white lace corset-style camisole with ruffled front and tie detail, pastel blue chunky cable-knit cardigan, light-wash wide-leg jeans, and white retro sneakers with light blue stripes. She carries a light blue floral shoulder bag with silver chain and layered silver necklaces.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body 9:16 low-angle portrait, subject standing confidently with legs comfortably apart, one hand holding the bag by her side. Frame her against a black metal arched gate completely surrounded by lush ivy and climbing vines on a stone path.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daytime sunlight with gentle shadows and clear sky, fresh garden atmosphere, pastel blue and green palette, realistic foliage texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens look, sharp subject, moderate depth of field, realistic skin and knit/fabric detail, subtle film grain, photorealistic fashion photography, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic full-body vertical 9:16 fashion portrait of one approved adult platinum-blonde woman with long wavy hair and fair skin, wearing a light blue fabric headband, white lace corset-style camisole with ruffled front and tie detail, pastel blue chunky cable-knit cardigan, light-wash wide-leg jeans, and white retro sneakers with light blue stripes. She carries a light blue floral shoulder bag with silver chain and layered silver necklaces. Confident relaxed stance on a stone path before a black metal arched garden gate framed by lush ivy and climbing vines, soft natural daylight, gentle shadows, fresh pastel blue-and-green palette, 35mm look, realistic texture, subtle film grain.
